panels.title: Per-endpoint stats (Peak/Avg RPS+RPM, p50/p95/p99, Error %, Share)

options.content:
## Filters
**Service** ($application) / **Endpoint** ($uri) / **Method** / **Profile window** at top.

## Metrics source
Spring Boot Micrometer: `http_server_requests_seconds_count`, `http_server_requests_seconds_bucket`.

## SLO
p95 < 200ms · p99 < 500ms · 5xx < 1%
